احتفرتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرَتَا (iḥtafaratā) /iħ.ta.fa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرَتَا (uḥtufiratā) /uħ.tu.fi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
